title: 안부 인사: 잘 지내요? 오랜만이에요
objective: By the end, you can greet someone you haven't seen for a while, ask how they are doing these days, and give a short answer about yourself.
summary: Learn ten everyday words for greeting people and asking how they have been, each in one short, natural sentence.

task.title: Choose and fill in
task.line: Pick the word that fits each sentence, or write the missing word in the blank.

words.meaning: to be well; used in the everyday greeting 'Hello'
to be doing, to get along (in daily life)
a long time since the last meeting
words.exampleMeaning: Wow, Sujin, long time no see!
How are you doing these days?

words.meaning: to be glad (to see or meet someone)
words.exampleMeaning: I'm glad to see you again.
I'm busy this week because I have a lot of work.

words.meaning: to be okay, to be all right
to be healthy, to be well
all this time, since we last met
words.exampleMeaning: Have you been well since we last met?

exercises: Choose the right word: ① 와, 지수 씨! 정말 (오랜만 / 요즘)이에요. ② 선생님, (안녕하세요 / 다음에)?
Fill in the blank with a form of 반갑다: A: 처음 뵙겠습니다. 저는 이민호예요. B: 네, ____. 저는 안나예요.
Choose the better reply to 「요즘 어떻게 지내요?」: ① 다음에 또 만나요. ② 시험이 있어서 좀 바빠요.
Fill in the blank with the past form of 지내다 (as in 그동안 잘 지냈어요?): 방학 동안 잘 ____?
Choose the right word: ① 감기는 이제 (괜찮아요 / 반가워요)? ② 운동을 매일 해서 (건강해요 / 바빠요). ③ 오늘은 시간이 없어요. (그동안 / 다음에) 만나요.
answers: ① 괜찮아요 ② 건강해요 ③ 다음에
